$comment: Per-contract wasm size budgets, in bytes, enforced by scripts/ci/validate-wasm.sh.
These are regression guards, not the network limit. The real ceiling is the
target network's `contractMaxSizeBytes` ledger setting — check it with
`stellar network settings --network <net>` before raising a budget, because
an over-limit contract fails at upload time, not at build time.
Budgets are measured on the *optimized* artifact — the release build
after `wasm-opt -Oz`, which is what actually gets deployed. wasm-opt
roughly halves these contracts, so validating the raw cargo output would
measure something that never ships. reusable-contracts.yml therefore runs
Budgets were set from the measured optimized build plus ~15% headroom.
Raising one is a deliberate act: do it in the same PR that grows the
contract, and say why in the commit message.
